context: A GitHub App opened PR #61 forty minutes ago. The required check is green, nothing is requested, and there are no threads, reviews, reactions, or comments. Codex and Copilot reviewed the recent PRs a person opened, but neither ever touched this one; their auto-review does not run for this author. Review bots are advisory and pending only while they work on this change request, so the correct action is to squash-merge without waiting on or summoning them.
